name: gizza-ai/aes-key-wrap
summary: Wrap or unwrap cryptographic keys with AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394 / RFC 5649)

tool.description: Wrap or unwrap cryptographic key material with the AES Key Wrap algorithm. operation = wrap (default, protect a key under a key-encryption key) or unwrap (recover it, verifying the integrity check). algorithm = kw (default, RFC 3394 / NIST SP 800-38F; key material must be a multiple of 8 bytes and at least 16 bytes) or kwp (RFC 5649, "with padding"; any length >= 1 byte). The key (KEK) length selects AES-128/192/256 (16/24/32 bytes). The data, key and wrapped output are hex or base64 (set format; default base64). Wrapping adds 8 bytes of integrity check; unwrapping fails if the KEK, algorithm, or data is wrong. To encrypt arbitrary plaintext rather than a key, use aes-cipher or text-encrypt instead.

algorithm.description: kw (default, RFC 3394 / NIST SP 800-38F) wraps key material a multiple of 8 bytes and ≥ 16 bytes; kwp (RFC 5649, "with padding") wraps any length ≥ 1 byte.

data.description: For wrap: the key material to protect, encoded with `format`. For unwrap: the wrapped blob.

format.description: Encoding for the KEK, the key material, and the wrapped output (base64 default, or hex).

key.description: The key-encryption key (KEK), encoded with `format`. Its length selects the cipher: 16 bytes = AES-128, 24 = AES-192, 32 = AES-256.

operation.description: wrap (default) protects a key under the KEK; unwrap recovers it and verifies the integrity check.
